metadata.verification: Every figure was extracted from the primary document and independently re-pulled from the SEC XBRL companyfacts API (data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK0000320193.json) filtered to form=10-K, end=2024-09-28, accn=0000320193-24-000123. Both sources agree exactly on total net sales, gross margin, operating income, net income, R&D, tax provision, basic/diluted EPS, total assets, total liabilities, total shareholders' equity, cash from operations, capex, cash and equivalents, inventories and total cost of sales. Values are transcribed verbatim from .polly/AAPL_FY2024_GROUND_TRUTH.md and must not be recomputed or edited in place.
notes: Fiscal 2024 was a 52-week year ended 2024-09-28; fiscal year is NOT the calendar year and is NOT the filing date year.
The filing was FILED on 2024-11-01 for FISCAL YEAR 2024. Matching on filing_date[:4] conflates the two and is a bug.
All dollar amounts are US$ millions unless the unit field says otherwise.

questions.question: What were Apple's total net sales in fiscal 2024?
questions.answer_text: Total net sales were $391,035 million (approximately $391.0 billion).
questions.source: Consolidated Statements of Operations; MD&A Segment Operating Performance

questions.question: By what percentage did Apple's total net sales change in fiscal 2024 compared to fiscal 2023?
questions.answer_text: Total net sales increased 2%, from $383,285 million in 2023 to $391,035 million in 2024.

questions.question: How much revenue did Apple's Services category generate in fiscal 2024, and how did it change year over year?
questions.answer_text: Services net sales were $96,169 million, up 13% from $85,200 million in 2023.

questions.question: What were Apple's iPhone net sales in fiscal 2024, and did they grow?
questions.answer_text: iPhone net sales were $201,183 million, essentially flat (0% change) versus $200,583 million in 2023. The filing describes them as 'relatively flat'.
questions.note: Grading must treat 'flat'/'unchanged'/'0%' as correct and 'increased'/'grew' as INCORRECT.

questions.question: Which product or service category grew fastest in fiscal 2024?
questions.answer_text: Services, which grew 13% to $96,169 million — the only category with double-digit growth.

questions.question: What were Apple's Greater China net sales in fiscal 2024, and how did they change?
questions.answer_text: Greater China net sales were $66,952 million, down 8% from $72,559 million in 2023.

questions.question: Which of Apple's reportable segments saw net sales decline in fiscal 2024?
questions.answer_text: Greater China was the only reportable segment with declining net sales (down 8%). Americas, Europe, Japan and Rest of Asia Pacific all grew.
questions.note: Spec grading: categorical, expected token 'Greater China'; answer must NOT name any other segment as declining.

questions.question: What was Apple's total gross margin in dollars in fiscal 2024?
questions.answer_text: Total gross margin was $180,683 million, up from $169,148 million in 2023.
questions.source: Consolidated Statements of Operations; MD&A Gross Margin table

questions.question: What was Apple's total gross margin percentage in fiscal 2024?
questions.answer_text: Total gross margin percentage was 46.2%, up from 44.1% in 2023.

questions.question: What was the gross margin percentage on Apple's Services business in fiscal 2024?
questions.answer_text: Services gross margin percentage was 73.9%, up from 70.8% in 2023, compared with 37.2% for Products.

questions.question: How much did Apple spend on research and development in fiscal 2024?
questions.answer_text: Research and development expense was $31,370 million, up 5% from $29,915 million in 2023, and about 8% of total net sales.
questions.source: MD&A Operating Expenses table; Consolidated Statements of Operations

questions.question: What were Apple's total operating expenses in fiscal 2024?
questions.answer_text: Total operating expenses were $57,467 million (R&D $31,370M plus SG&A $26,097M), up 5% year over year and about 15% of total net sales.

questions.question: What was Apple's operating income in fiscal 2024?
questions.answer_text: Operating income was $123,216 million, up from $114,301 million in 2023 — an operating margin of about 31.5%.

questions.question: What was Apple's net income in fiscal 2024, and how did it compare to fiscal 2023?
questions.answer_text: Net income was $93,736 million, DOWN about 3.4% from $96,995 million in 2023, despite net sales growing 2%. The decline is driven by the one-time State Aid tax charge.
questions.note: Grading must mark any answer claiming net income increased as INCORRECT.

questions.question: What was Apple's diluted earnings per share in fiscal 2024?
questions.answer_text: Diluted EPS was $6.08 (basic EPS $6.11), versus diluted $6.13 in 2023.
questions.note: Do not accept 6.11 — that is BASIC EPS. The 0.005 tolerance is what enforces this.

questions.question: What was Apple's effective tax rate in fiscal 2024?
questions.answer_text: The effective tax rate was 24.1%, up from 14.7% in 2023 and above the 21% U.S. statutory federal rate.
questions.source: MD&A Provision for Income Taxes; Note 7

questions.question: Why was Apple's fiscal 2024 effective tax rate higher than the statutory federal rate?
questions.answer_text: Primarily a one-time income tax charge of $10.2 billion, net, related to the European Commission State Aid Decision ($10,246 million in the rate reconciliation). Apple owed EUR 14.2 billion / $15.8 billion to Ireland as of September 28, 2024.
questions.note: Spec grading: keyword — answer must mention 'State Aid' and the $10.2 billion charge.
questions.source: MD&A Provision for Income Taxes; Note 7 Income Taxes

questions.question: How much cash did Apple generate from operating activities in fiscal 2024?
questions.answer_text: Cash generated by operating activities was $118,254 million, up from $110,543 million in 2023.

questions.question: What were Apple's total assets and total shareholders' equity as of September 28, 2024?
questions.answer_text: Total assets were $364,980 million and total shareholders' equity was $56,950 million. Equity DECLINED from $62,146 million a year earlier because buybacks and dividends exceeded net income.
questions.note: The question does not ask for a direction, so no direction word is required; but claiming equity rose is wrong (62,146 -> 56,950) and scores zero.

questions.question: How much common stock did Apple repurchase in fiscal 2024?
questions.answer_text: Apple repurchased 499 million shares for $95.0 billion during fiscal 2024. In May 2024 it announced a new repurchase program of up to $110 billion and raised the quarterly dividend from $0.24 to $0.25 per share.
questions.note: Cash-flow-statement figure is $94,949M (cash paid); the share-repurchase note says $95.0 billion. The 0.15 usd_billions tolerance accepts either.
questions.source: MD&A Capital Return Program; Note 9 Shareholders' Equity
